title: Lifesaver!
body:
Thank you for this lifesaver app! The daily tasks are broken down very clearly and simply and the organisation that is missing in your head is in the app. 

The possibility to rate messages is also great, but I miss the option for German messages and content! I'll give it 5 stars if the app also runs in German! Great Job ♥️
author: LizzzzGeeee

title: I have never opened a site before and thought „this is it“
body:
Well, THIS IS IT. And it is free, except a tiny one time Payment for the app, if you want it.

Me and my Executive Function, my Anxiety and my Scattered Brain would like to thank you for this. You make a change in peoples life, and I am so grateful to have found you. 🩷
author: The Swiss Army Knife of Autism

title: Absolut life saver
body:
I wish there was an option to make either more to-do lists or prioritise the tasks and divide in themes (like office stuff in one list and cleaning stuff in another or something like that). 

Other than that I love this app so much! I hope it’ll be available forever 💕
author: Ichmagaber

title: Really helpful for adhd suffering person!
body: I‘m so happy I randomly found this, it‘s so so helpful
